title: The w-localization of an affine scheme is ind-Zariski, faithfully flat and has the expected closed points and specializations
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file proetale.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma collects the five basic properties of the w-localization X_w of an affine scheme: A -> A_w is ind-Zariski and faithfully flat, X_w -> X is bijective on Z, Z is the set of closed points, Z is reduced, and every point of X_w specializes to a unique point of Z, so that X_w is w-local (statement lines 843-855). The proof (proof lines 857-900) derives faithful flatness from surjectivity, identifies the closed points through closures of images in the partial w-localizations, proves uniqueness of specializations by a two-point separation argument, and proves reducedness from the explicit description of Z_E. H3: five interlocking statements with an original specialization argument, all written out in full.
